node.statement: Exact idempotence at the pinned display forces one full unit of transverse moment: combining the moment identity for the display row with the pinned masses gives sum_Q c_Q * x_Q = 1 when the identity is normalized against the transverse direction D, i.e. the display row must supply transverse moment exactly 1.
